## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.

## What's Changed

### ✨ Features

* Honor per-host `api_host` routing across GitHub API requests by @williammartin in [#14104](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14104)
* Expose `api_host` through `gh config get` and `gh config set` by @williammartin in [#14332](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14332)
* Add `webhook` as an official extension by @williammartin in [#14326](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14326)
* Print full command help after command misuse when `gh` is invoked by a coding agent by @niik in [#14198](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14198)

### 🐛 Fixes

* fix(api): disable telemetry for unauthenticated GHES requests using absolute hostnames by @williammartin in [#14337](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14337)

### 📚 Docs & Chores

* Fix discussion acceptance test flags by @williammartin in [#14321](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14321)
* Clarify supported GHES versions by @williammartin in [#14324](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14324)
* Improve automated issue triage analysis by @sergiou87 in [#14318](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14318)
* Record attachment counts in telemetry by @BagToad in [#14327](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14327)

### :dependabot: Dependencies

* chore(deps): bump `golang.org/x/crypto` from 0.55.0 to 0.56.0 by @babakks in [#14331](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14331)
* chore(deps): bump Go toolchain from 1.26.7 to 1.26.8 by @babakks in [#14330](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14330)
* chore(deps): bump `github.com/cli/go-gh/v2` from 2.15.0 to 2.16.0 by @williammartin in [#14338](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14338)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cli/cli/compare/v2.99.0...v2.100.0
